test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four options have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
**Meditate is the odd one out.**

It is a practice that connects the mind and the body in order to get peace.

While other three terms - sleep, snore, dream are related to sleeping.

Hence,** 'option 1'** is the correct answer.
